concerns.text: FR-002 (Statistical Analysis Engine) and Plan Phase 3 require Repeated Measures ANOVA and Holm-Bonferroni correction. Task T023a (ANOVA implementation) and T026 (Metrics Summary generation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these tasks completed, the system cannot satisfy the core statistical requirement of the spec.

FR-005 (Data Cleaning) and Plan Phase 2 require filtering incomplete sessions and imputing SUS scores. Task T021c (Orchestrate cleaning pipeline) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The pipeline cannot produce the `cleaned_sessions.csv` artifact required for downstream analysis without this task.

FR-006 (Power Analysis) requires computing statistical power. Task T036b (Generate Power Analysis Report) is marked [ ] (incomplete). While T036 computes flags, the final report integration required by the Plan is missing.

Plan Phase 1 requires a deterministic simulator for pilot testing. Tasks T031-gen, T031-cli, and T031b (Simulator implementation and validation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The project lacks the mechanism to generate test data for CI validation as required by the Plan.

Plan Phase 4 requires a reproducible Jupyter notebook and GitHub Actions workflow. Task T029b (GitHub Actions Workflow) is marked [ ] (incomplete). This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) as the automated verification step is missing.

FR-007 (Web-Based Simulator) and Constitution Principle VI (N=30) require sample size verification. Task T043 (Sample Size Verification) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The pipeline cannot enforce the constitutional N≥30 gate before analysis.

Task T021a and T021b are marked [X] (complete), but T021c (Orchestration) is [ ]. The description of T021c references T021a/b as dependencies, but the lack of orchestration means the cleaning logic is not executable. This is a planning gap where the 'glue' task is missing.
